My Personal Details

What is your legal full name?

Enter the name that appears on official identity documents (Social Security card, passport, or birth certificate).
If you are updating or correcting your name, your new name must match the name on file with the Social Security Administration.

On your license or ID card, your name will appear on two lines. Your last name will be on the first line and should appear with hyphens, spaces, or apostrophes. There is a character limit of 35. Your first and middle names will appear together on the second line. Enter it as you would like it to read with hyphens, spaces, or apostrophes.

Do you have a Social Security number? *

If you have a Social Security Number you must select Yes. Your Social Security Number is required if you plan on applying for a Commercial Driver's License.
